visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a black t-shirt sits on a light grey couch, holding a handheld microphone and singing with exaggerated passion. Next to him, a woman with long dark hair, wearing a pink cardigan over a red top, initially looks at her smartphone before looking up at the man with a skeptical and increasingly annoyed expression. The setting is a modern, brightly lit living room with white walls and a kitchen area in the background. (2) As the singing continues, the man gestures with his free hand while looking directly at the camera or at the woman. The woman reacts to his provocative lyrics by crossing her arms, rolling her eyes, and eventually shouting back at him. On-screen text overlays display the parody lyrics in white font. The camera remains mostly static at eye-level. (3) The scene cuts abruptly to a bedroom. A man is lying on a bed with a black sleep mask on his face. A white dog and a black dog are on the bed with him. The woman suddenly enters the frame from the left and begins hitting the man repeatedly with a white pillow, causing him to sit up and shield himself in a startled manner. The lighting shifts to a slightly cooler indoor tone.
